mapper.select: SELECT direction_id,code,display_name,description,status,sort_order,created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM zentide_hub_direction WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC,direction_id ASC
SELECT direction_id,code,display_name,description,status,sort_order,created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM zentide_hub_direction WHERE code=#{code} AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_hub_direction(code,display_name,description,status,sort_order,created_by) VALUES(#{code},#{displayName},#{description},#{status},#{sortOrder},#{createdBy})
mapper.sql: h.*, CASE WHEN hm.membership_status='ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS joined, CASE WHEN h.owner_id=#{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owned, hm.membership_status, hm.role AS member_role, hm.permissions_json AS member_permissions, hc.category_id AS personal_category_id, hc.name AS personal_category_name
LEFT JOIN zentide_hub_member hm ON hm.hub_id=h.hub_id AND hm.user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN zentide_hub_category hc ON hc.category_id=hm.category_id AND hc.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM zentide_hub h
WHERE h.status='ACTIVE' AND h.visibility='PUBLIC' AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR hm.membership_status='ACTIVE' OR h.owner_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN h.owner_id=#{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(hc.sort_order,999999),h.member_count DESC,h.post_count DESC,h.hub_id DESC

SELECT h.*,u.nick_name AS owner_name FROM zentide_hub h LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=h.owner_id WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR h.status=#{status}) AND (#{query} IS NULL OR h.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR h.slug LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_hub SET status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE hub_id=#{hubId}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM zentide_hub h
WHERE h.status='ACTIVE' AND h.visibility='PUBLIC' AND (#{query} IS NULL OR h.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR h.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) AND (#{category} IS NULL OR h.category=#{category} OR (#{category}='TECHNOLOGY' AND h.category='AI')) ORDER BY h.member_count DESC,h.post_count DESC,h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.post_id AS id, p.title, LEFT(p.body, 240) AS summary, p.hub_id, h.name AS hub_name, p.created_at FROM zentide_interest_post p JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND h.status='ACTIVE' AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR p.body LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.hub_id AS id, h.name AS title, h.description AS summary, h.category, h.member_count, h.post_count FROM zentide_hub h WHERE h.status='ACTIVE' AND h.visibility='PUBLIC' AND (h.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR h.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY h.member_count DESC, h.post_count DESC, h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_user_action f WHERE f.interest_entity_id=e.entity_id AND f.action_type='FOLLOW' AND f.status='ACTIVE') AS follower_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_interest_post p WHERE p.entity_id=e.entity_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED') AS post_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_interest_event x WHERE x.entity_id=e.entity_id AND x.status='UPCOMING') AS event_count, CASE WHEN ef.user_action_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS followed, ea.action_value AS my_action FROM zentide_interest_entity e LEFT JOIN zentide_user_action ef ON ef.interest_entity_id=e.entity_id AND ef.user_id=#{userId} AND ef.action_type='FOLLOW' AND ef.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN zentide_user_action ea ON ea.interest_entity_id=e.entity_id AND ea.user_id=#{userId} AND ea.action_type='ACTION' AND ea.status='ACTIVE' WHERE e.status='ACTIVE' AND (#{hubId} IS NULL OR e.hub_id=#{hubId}) ORDER BY event_count DESC,follower_count DESC,e.entity_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: p.*,h.name AS hub_name,e.title AS event_title,c.title AS change_title,c.summary AS change_summary, COALESCE(pt.display_name,p.post_type) AS post_type_label, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label, CASE WHEN pr.action_value='LIKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, CASE WHEN pb.user_action_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS bookmarked, pa.action_value AS my_action

JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN zentide_post_type pt ON pt.type_code=p.post_type LEFT JOIN zentide_interest_event e ON e.event_id=p.event_id LEFT JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=p.change_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN zentide_user_action pr ON pr.post_id=p.post_id AND pr.user_id=#{userId} AND pr.action_type='REACTION' AND pr.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN zentide_user_action pb ON pb.post_id=p.post_id AND pb.user_id=#{userId} AND pb.action_type='BOOKMARK' AND pb.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN zentide_user_action pa ON pa.post_id=p.post_id AND pa.user_id=#{userId} AND pa.action_type='ACTION' AND pa.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM zentide_interest_post p
WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND h.status='ACTIVE' AND (#{hubId} IS NULL OR p.hub_id=#{hubId}) AND (#{postType} IS NULL OR p.post_type=#{postType}) AND (#{topicId} IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zentide_topic_link ipt WHERE ipt.post_id=p.post_id AND ipt.topic_id=#{topicId} )) AND (#{changeId} IS NULL OR p.change_id=#{changeId}) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.*,h.name AS hub_name,u.nick_name AS author_label, COALESCE(pt.display_name,p.post_type) AS post_type_label FROM zentide_interest_post p JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=p.author_id LEFT JOIN zentide_post_type pt ON pt.type_code=p.post_type WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR p.status=#{status}) AND (#{hubId} IS NULL OR p.hub_id=#{hubId}) AND (#{query} IS NULL OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR p.body LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_interest_post SET status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE post_id=#{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT author_id FROM zentide_interest_post WHERE post_id=#{postId} LIMIT 1
SELECT hub_id FROM zentide_interest_post WHERE post_id=#{postId} LIMIT 1
SELECT post_id FROM zentide_interest_post WHERE hub_id=#{hubId}
SELECT p.post_id FROM zentide_interest_post p JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND h.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT c.*,p.title AS post_title,h.name AS hub_name, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label,u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM zentide_interest_comment c JOIN zentide_interest_post p ON p.post_id=c.post_id JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=c.author_id WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR c.status=#{status}) AND (#{hubId} IS NULL OR p.hub_id=#{hubId}) AND (#{query} IS NULL OR c.body LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_interest_comment SET status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE comment_id=#{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT post_id FROM zentide_interest_comment WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.topic_id,t.canonical_name,t.topic_type,t.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_topic_link l WHERE l.topic_id=t.topic_id AND l.post_id IS NOT NULL) AS post_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_topic_link l WHERE l.topic_id=t.topic_id AND l.hub_id IS NOT NULL) AS hub_count FROM zentide_topic t WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR t.status=#{status}) AND (#{query} IS NULL OR t.canonical_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC,t.topic_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_topic SET status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE topic_id=#{topicId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_interest_post WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_interest_comment WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_hub_member WHERE membership_status='PENDING'

SELECT FROM zentide_interest_post p
WHERE p.post_id=#{postId} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_interest_post SET view_count=view_count+1 WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='zentide_interest_post' AND column_name='view_count'

SELECT e.*,h.name AS hub_name,ea.action_value AS attendance_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_user_action x WHERE x.event_id=e.event_id AND x.action_type='ATTENDANCE' AND x.status='ACTIVE') AS attendee_count FROM zentide_interest_event e JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=e.hub_id LEFT JOIN zentide_user_action ea ON ea.event_id=e.event_id AND ea.user_id=#{userId} AND ea.action_type='ATTENDANCE' AND ea.status='ACTIVE' WHERE e.status='UPCOMING' AND (#{hubId} IS NULL OR e.hub_id=#{hubId}) ORDER BY e.starts_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.*,h.name AS hub_name FROM zentide_interest_event e JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=e.hub_id WHERE e.hub_id=#{hubId} AND e.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY COALESCE(e.starts_at,e.created_at) ASC,e.event_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_interest_event(hub_id,entity_id,title,description,starts_at,ends_at,venue,source_url,status) VALUES(#{hubId},#{entityId},#{title},#{description},#{startsAt},#{endsAt},#{venue},#{sourceUrl},'UPCOMING')
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_interest_event e JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=e.hub_id SET e.title=#{event.title},e.description=#{event.description},e.starts_at=#{event.startsAt},e.ends_at=#{event.endsAt},e.venue=#{event.venue},e.source_url=#{event.sourceUrl},e.status=#{event.status},e.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE e.event_id=#{event.eventId} AND e.status<>'DELETED'
UPDATE zentide_interest_event e JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=e.hub_id SET e.status='CANCELLED',e.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE e.event_id=#{eventId} AND e.status<>'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT #{eventId} AS event_id, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='WANT' AND status='ACTIVE'),0) AS want_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='ATTENDING' AND status='ACTIVE'),0) AS attending_count, COALESCE(SUM(action_value='ATTENDED' AND status='ACTIVE'),0) AS attended_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='ACTIVE'),0) AS total_participants FROM zentide_user_action WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND action_type='ATTENDANCE'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'POST' AS kind,p.post_id,NULL AS comment_id,p.hub_id,h.name AS hub_name,p.title,p.body,p.author_id, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label,p.like_count,p.comment_count,p.bookmark_count,p.view_count,p.created_at FROM zentide_interest_post p JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=p.author_id WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_hub_member hm WHERE hm.hub_id=p.hub_id AND hm.user_id=#{userId} AND hm.membership_status='ACTIVE') OR h.owner_id=#{userId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT' AS kind,c.post_id,c.comment_id,p.hub_id,h.name AS hub_name,p.title,c.body,c.author_id, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label,c.like_count,p.comment_count,p.bookmark_count,p.view_count,c.created_at FROM zentide_interest_comment c JOIN zentide_interest_post p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED' JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=c.author_id WHERE c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_hub_member hm WHERE hm.hub_id=p.hub_id AND hm.user_id=#{userId} AND hm.membership_status='ACTIVE') OR h.owner_id=#{userId}) ) highlights WHERE
comment_count view_count bookmark_count
>= #{minCount} ORDER BY
comment_count view_count bookmark_count
DESC,like_count DESC,created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'POST' AS kind,p.post_id,NULL AS comment_id,p.hub_id,h.name AS hub_name,p.title,p.body,p.author_id, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label,p.like_count,p.comment_count,p.bookmark_count,0 AS view_count,p.created_at FROM zentide_interest_post p JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=p.author_id WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_hub_member hm WHERE hm.hub_id=p.hub_id AND hm.user_id=#{userId} AND hm.membership_status='ACTIVE') OR h.owner_id=#{userId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT' AS kind,c.post_id,c.comment_id,p.hub_id,h.name AS hub_name,p.title,c.body,c.author_id, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label,c.like_count,p.comment_count,p.bookmark_count,0 AS view_count,c.created_at FROM zentide_interest_comment c JOIN zentide_interest_post p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED' JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=c.author_id WHERE c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_hub_member hm WHERE hm.hub_id=p.hub_id AND hm.user_id=#{userId} AND hm.membership_status='ACTIVE') OR h.owner_id=#{userId}) ) highlights WHERE
comment_count bookmark_count
>= #{minCount} ORDER BY
comment_count bookmark_count
DESC,like_count DESC,created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.avatar,u.join_time,u.handle,u.bio,u.cover_url,u.location,u.website_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_interest_post p WHERE p.author_id=u.user_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED') AS posts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_user_action f WHERE f.target_user_id=u.user_id AND f.action_type='FOLLOW' AND f.status='ACTIVE') AS followers_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_user_action f WHERE f.user_id=u.user_id AND f.target_user_id IS NOT NULL AND f.action_type='FOLLOW' AND f.status='ACTIVE') AS following_count, CASE WHEN #{viewerId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zentide_user_action f WHERE f.user_id=#{viewerId} AND f.target_user_id=u.user_id AND f.action_type='FOLLOW' AND f.status='ACTIVE' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS followed_by_me FROM user_info u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status=1 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*,h.name AS hub_name,e.title AS event_title, COALESCE(pt.display_name,p.post_type) AS post_type_label, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label FROM zentide_interest_post p JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN zentide_post_type pt ON pt.type_code=p.post_type LEFT JOIN zentide_interest_event e ON e.event_id=p.event_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=p.author_id WHERE p.author_id=#{userId} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.*,p.title AS post_title,h.name AS hub_name FROM zentide_interest_comment c JOIN zentide_interest_post p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED' JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id WHERE c.author_id=#{userId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.*,h.name AS hub_name,e.title AS event_title, COALESCE(pt.display_name,p.post_type) AS post_type_label, COALESCE(u.nick_name,'社区成员') AS author_label, 1 AS bookmarked FROM zentide_user_action a JOIN zentide_interest_post p ON p.post_id=a.post_id AND p.status='PUBLISHED' JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=p.hub_id LEFT JOIN zentide_post_type pt ON pt.type_code=p.post_type LEFT JOIN zentide_interest_event e ON e.event_id=p.event_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=p.author_id WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.action_type='BOOKMARK' AND a.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT hm.hub_id,hm.user_id,u.nick_name,u.avatar,hm.membership_status,hm.role,hm.permissions_json,hm.application_note,hm.created_at FROM zentide_hub_member hm JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=hm.user_id WHERE hm.hub_id=#{hubId} AND hm.membership_status='PENDING' ORDER BY hm.created_at

SELECT hm.hub_id,hm.user_id,u.nick_name,u.avatar,hm.membership_status,hm.role,hm.permissions_json,hm.application_note,hm.created_at,hm.updated_at FROM zentide_hub_member hm JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=hm.user_id WHERE hm.hub_id=#{hubId} AND hm.membership_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE hm.role WHEN 'OWNER' THEN 0 WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, hm.created_at
SELECT hm.hub_id,hm.user_id,hm.membership_status,hm.role,hm.permissions_json FROM zentide_hub_member hm WHERE hm.hub_id=#{hubId} AND hm.user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_hub_member SET role=#{role}, permissions_json=CAST(#{permissionsJson} AS JSON), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE hub_id=#{hubId} AND user_id=#{memberId} AND role<>'OWNER' AND membership_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT hm.hub_id,hm.user_id,h.name AS hub_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,hm.membership_status,hm.created_at FROM zentide_hub_member hm JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=hm.hub_id JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=hm.user_id WHERE hm.membership_status='PENDING' ORDER BY hm.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM zentide_hub WHERE hub_id=#{hubId} AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT t.topic_id,t.canonical_name,t.topic_type,ht.hub_id,ht.counter_value AS post_count,ht.featured FROM zentide_topic_link ht JOIN zentide_topic t ON t.topic_id=ht.topic_id WHERE ht.hub_id=#{hubId} AND t.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY ht.featured DESC,ht.counter_value DESC,t.canonical_name ASC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.select: SELECT pt.*,h.name AS hub_name FROM zentide_post_type pt LEFT JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=pt.hub_id WHERE pt.status='ACTIVE' AND ((pt.system_fixed=1 AND pt.hub_id IS NULL) OR (#{hubId} IS NOT NULL AND pt.hub_id=#{hubId})) ORDER BY pt.system_fixed DESC,pt.sort_order,pt.post_type_id

SELECT pt.*,h.name AS hub_name FROM zentide_post_type pt LEFT JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=pt.hub_id WHERE pt.hub_id=#{hubId} AND pt.system_fixed=0 AND pt.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY pt.sort_order,pt.post_type_id
SELECT pt.* FROM zentide_post_type pt WHERE pt.system_fixed=1 AND pt.hub_id IS NULL AND pt.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY pt.sort_order,pt.post_type_id

mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_post_type SET status='DELETED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE post_type_id=#{postTypeId} AND hub_id=#{hubId} AND system_fixed=0 AND status<>'DELETED'

UPDATE zentide_post_type SET display_name=#{displayName},description=#{description},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE post_type_id=#{postTypeId} AND hub_id=#{hubId} AND system_fixed=0 AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE zentide_post_type SET display_name=#{displayName},description=#{description},status=#{status},sort_order=#{sortOrder},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE post_type_id=#{postTypeId} AND system_fixed=1 AND hub_id IS NULL AND status<>'DELETED'
UPDATE zentide_post_type SET status='DELETED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE post_type_id=#{postTypeId} AND system_fixed=1 AND hub_id IS NULL AND status<>'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT h.hub_id,h.name AS hub_name,t.topic_id,t.canonical_name AS topic_name,c.change_id,c.title AS change_title,c.summary AS change_summary FROM zentide_topic_link tc JOIN zentide_topic_link ht ON ht.topic_id=tc.topic_id AND ht.hub_id IS NOT NULL JOIN zentide_hub h ON h.hub_id=ht.hub_id JOIN zentide_topic t ON t.topic_id=tc.topic_id JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=tc.change_id WHERE tc.change_id=#{changeId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED' AND h.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY ht.featured DESC,ht.counter_value DESC,h.hub_id LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_topic_link tc JOIN zentide_topic_link ht ON ht.topic_id=tc.topic_id AND ht.hub_id IS NOT NULL JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=tc.change_id WHERE ht.hub_id=#{hubId} AND tc.topic_id=#{topicId} AND tc.change_id=#{changeId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED'
